title: Event B1 (Inter RAT neighbour becomes better than threshold)

entities.name: Event B1
entities.description: Measurement event triggered when an inter-RAT neighbour cell becomes better than a specified threshold.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that performs measurement reporting based on network configuration.

entities.name: Inter RAT neighbour
entities.description: Neighbour cell using a different radio access technology than the serving cell.

entities.name: Threshold
entities.description: Configured measurement threshold value that triggers Event B1 when exceeded.
